title: Blur anyone who did not agree to be filmed
summary: Your AI can make a copy of any video with every face blurred except the people who agreed.

payload.title: Blur anyone who did not agree
payload.body: Ask your AI to blur everyone but the people who agreed, and give it a picture and a short recording of each of them. You get a copy with every other face blurred and every other voice silenced; the original stays as it was.
